notes: City of Amarillo, TX: the whole city within city limits, across Potter County (187 km2) and Randall County (93 km2). Built by data/jurisidictions/run_amarillo.py (prad_county.py, shared runner tx_multicounty.py). 81,230 parcels, $2.27B land (Potter $937M, Randall $1.33B). All values 2026. Amarillo's land is inexpensive: median $1.38/sqft, highest $25.

Values: Potter-Randall Appraisal District's 2026 certified exports, one per county (PACS 8.0.33, exported 2026-10-01 with supplements), joined on prop_id to PRAD's 2026 certified GIS parcels; both downloaded by hand from PRAD's data share. Check: PRAD's taxable land on City of Amarillo accounts is $941.7M (Potter, FP) + $1,349.8M (Randall, FR) = $2.29B vs $2.27B kept; 0.4% / 0.7% of it is on records the certified map does not draw (mostly office / business condo units).
City limits: Census TIGER/Line 2025 place 4803000; the City of Amarillo entities (FP, FR) agree on all but 4 / 19 accounts.
Exempt land dropped: the rolls' EX flags and state class X, plus named public owners (Amarillo College: 275 parcels, City, Hospital District): 2,153 records. 264 utility records left off.
Land size: on 1,003 parcels the polygon is a fragment of the roll's acreage and the appraiser's area is used (rural and edge tracts drawn partially); 67 remnants hidden.

Singularity sweep: 387 parcels >= 4x their neighbourhood, nearly all commercial frontage pads at $12-18/sqft next to residential land at ~$1.30. Review item: Glidden & Sanborn blk 120 W 93.36ft of lot 6 (Panhandle Pure LLC): PRAD values its 5,314 sqft at $141,570 of land ($25/sqft) among lots valued at ~$0.09/sqft; published as PRAD's value.
Under 100k parcels: browser GeoParquet path, no PMTiles bake.

Parking is OSM delivered through Overture Maps (release 2026-10-21.0, --overture-only), classified surface vs structure: 2,039 lots, 1,017.6 acres, $130M est. land value. apply_parking_category.py tagged 148 parcels 'Parking Lot'.
Links: PRAD's property page pinned to 2026 (prad.org/property-detail/<prop_id>/2026; confirmed by the user).
